statement: Artifact-and-tooling result (not a mathematics claim and NOT a second F2b verdict). Card audit-r2-F2b-a/-bindchain-worker-015 was delivered twice to worker-015: the slot had already executed it at 2026-09-12T00:51:39+08:00 (reviews/F2b-review-rev27-a.json sha256 73aacfbc36f5, review event review-worker-015-F2b-rev27-a at reviewed_sha256 55d0a1ea9bda, checkpoint d9e3ef8ae49e), so the mandated verdict path already existed; this re-entry left it unread and untouched and emitted no competing review vote. The card pin 55d0a1ea was verified by me before and after reading (both equal the pin), and the canonical+mirror paths moved to rev13 b2ab6acb2bbe at 00:53:20 (FROZEN rev29 3d9e3d77fd87 re-pins both; delta note: consistency-evidence pin refresh only, no class-semantics change). Re-entry verification at rev13: declared_f0_sha256 0abb9ed8a961 equals measured research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml; consistency_evidence_sha256 9e335e9ba1bf equals measured artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json (check_taxonomy_consistency.py re-run CONSISTENT, evidence byte-stable across the run); both class-contract pointers resolve; declared F0 bytes unchanged. Two content defects found at the rev12 bytes persist at rev13: (i) line 246 'C2 is a strictly larger extension class' contradicts the file's own containment chain at line 238, where E_C2 is the smallest extension class (the row's conclusion is correct; the premise token is inverted); (ii) line 152 'No containment with C2 or C0 is asserted here' is in tension with line 238 unless read as scoped to its bullet. Soft flag at rev12:316 / rev13:317 (H2_loc token in provenance.sources) is disposed as annotation, not leak: it is an unresolved literature concept the schema must not conflate, carries no class_id key, and class_separation.findings is empty in declaration and prose modes with no unknown AF-* tokens. Recommended routing: the standing astra-life05-verify-gform-r3 card (rev13 / FROZEN rev29) should carry W015-RE-01 and W015-RE-02. Blindness disclosure: after the artifact analysis, a map-node extraction script echoed accepted-stream F2b review events this session did not seek; therefore this re-entry does not present itself as the card's blind independent verdict.
